continuity_review: Both source rows use the approved row9 transform. Lower-body anchors remain planted; changes at000->022.5 and157.5->180 include head/cheek/hair silhouette changes that trigger metric warnings. Native labeled review finds a continuous ordered head-gaze family without wrong quadrants, body rotation, clipping or accidental alpha holes.
